 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The word spelled correctly is "Belligerent".**
 
• The term "Belligerent" is an adjective, which means 'hostile and aggressive'.
 
• **Example Sentence:** The belligerent nations refused to negotiate peace terms.
 
• Incorrect spellings provided in the options:
 
 
• "Beligerent" - missing an 'l'.
 
• "Belligerant" - incorrect ending with 'ant'.
 
• "Beligerant" - missing an 'l' and incorrect ending with 'ant'.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The term "Belligerent" is derived from the Latin word "belligerans," meaning 'waging war'.
 
• It is commonly used to describe individuals, groups, or nations that demonstrate aggression or hostility.
 
• **Synonyms:** Aggressive, combative, hostile.
 
• **Antonyms:** Peaceful, amicable, conciliatory.
